description: This file defines the PHP class 'JobTitle' within the 'OrangeHRM' HRM system. The class is an entity mapped to the 'ohrm_job_title' database table and includes properties for job title data and relationships to employees and attachments. It contains constants, private properties with ORM annotations, a constructor, and getter/setter methods for each property.

classes.name: JobTitle
classes.description: An entity class representing a job title with related properties and ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the job title.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the job title.

methods.name: getJobTitleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the job title.

methods.name: setJobTitleName
methods.description: Sets the name of the job title.

methods.name: getJobDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the job position.

methods.name: setJobDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the job position.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns optional notes about the job title.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets optional notes about the job title.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks whether the job title is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the job title as deleted or active.

methods.name: setJobSpecificationAttachment
methods.description: Associates a job specification attachment with this job title.
